description: Test whether the HID1 C-terminal domain occupies the concave face of its own alpha-solenoid
code:
import requests, collections, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"research-agent/1.0"}
pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8IV36-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=H,timeout=180).text
at=collections.defaultdict(list); ca={}; plb={}
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        n=int(l[22:26]); xyz=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))
        at[n].append(xyz)
        if l[12:16].strip()=="CA": ca[n]=xyz; plb[n]=float(l[60:66])
N=max(at)
CA=np.array([ca[i] for i in range(1,N+1)]); plddt=np.array([plb[i] for i in range(1,N+1)])
cent=np.array([np.mean(at[i],0) for i in range(1,N+1)])
D=np.linalg.norm(cent[:,None]-cent[None,:],axis=-1)

# ---- 1. how much surface does the C-terminal domain bury on the solenoid? ----
core=np.arange(0,600); ct=np.arange(689,788); lnk=np.arange(600,689)
nbr_all=(D<10).sum(1)-1
keep=np.ones(N,bool); keep[ct]=False
nbr_noct=(D[:,keep]<10).sum(1)-1
delta=nbr_all-nbr_noct
buried_by_ct=np.where((delta>=3)&(np.arange(N)<600))[0]+1
print(f"Core residues losing >=3 neighbours when 690-788 is removed: {len(buried_by_ct)}")
print("  ", buried_by_ct.tolist())
print(f"Mean pLDDT of that interface: {plddt[buried_by_ct-1].mean():.1f}")

# ---- 2. is the solenoid concave face self-occupied? ----
# helix segments from CA geometry
def dd(i,j): return np.linalg.norm(CA[i]-CA[j])
ss=np.array(["C"]*N,dtype="<U1")
for i in range(N-4):
    if 4.6<=dd(i,i+3)<=6.3 and 5.0<=dd(i,i+4)<=7.0 and 5.0<=dd(i,i+2)<=6.4: ss[i:i+5]="H"
segs=[];cur=None
for i,c in enumerate(ss):
    if c=="H" and cur is None: cur=i
    elif c!="H" and cur is not None:
        if i-cur>=7 and i<600: segs.append((cur,i-1))
        cur=None
hc=np.array([CA[a:b+1].mean(0) for a,b in segs])
# best-fit plane of the helix-centroid path, then fit a circle in that plane
mu=hc.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(hc-mu); e1,e2,e3=Vt
P=np.c_[(hc-mu)@e1,(hc-mu)@e2]
A=np.c_[2*P,np.ones(len(P))]; b=(P**2).sum(1)
sol,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,b,rcond=None); c2=sol[:2]; R=np.sqrt(sol[2]+c2@c2)
resid=np.abs(np.linalg.norm(P-c2,axis=1)-R)
print(f"\nSolenoid superhelix: {len(segs)} helices in 1-600; best-fit circle radius {R:.1f} A, rmsd of helix centroids to circle {resid.mean():.1f} A")
print(f"  arc spanned by helix centroids: {np.degrees(np.ptp(np.unwrap(np.arctan2(*(P-c2).T[::-1])))):.0f} deg")
ctr3=mu+c2[0]*e1+c2[1]*e2                       # concave centre in 3D
d_core_axis=np.linalg.norm(cent[core]-ctr3,axis=1)
d_ct_axis=np.linalg.norm(cent[ct]-ctr3,axis=1)
print(f"  distance to concave centre: solenoid residues median {np.median(d_core_axis):.1f} A; C-term 690-788 median {np.median(d_ct_axis):.1f} A")
print(f"  fraction of C-term residues inside the solenoid radius ({R:.0f} A): {np.mean(d_ct_axis<R):.2f}")

# ---- 3. per-helix: which helices line the concave face, and are they covered? ----
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,5))
axs[0].plot(P[:,0],P[:,1],"o-",color="#2a6ebb",label="helix centroids 1-600")
th=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,200); axs[0].plot(c2[0]+R*np.cos(th),c2[1]+R*np.sin(th),"--",color="grey",label=f"fitted circle R={R:.0f} A")
Pc=np.c_[(cent[ct]-mu)@e1,(cent[ct]-mu)@e2]
axs[0].scatter(Pc[:,0],Pc[:,1],s=12,color="#c0392b",label="C-term 690-788")
Pl=np.c_[(cent[lnk]-mu)@e1,(cent[lnk]-mu)@e2]
axs[0].scatter(Pl[:,0],Pl[:,1],s=8,color="#bdc3c7",label="linker 601-689")
axs[0].plot(c2[0],c2[1],"k+",ms=12); axs[0].set_aspect("equal")
axs[0].legend(fontsize=8); axs[0].set_title("HID1 solenoid projected on its best-fit plane")
axs[0].set_xlabel("A"); axs[0].set_ylabel("A")
axs[1].hist(d_core_axis,bins=30,alpha=0.6,label="solenoid 1-600",color="#2a6ebb")
axs[1].hist(d_ct_axis,bins=20,alpha=0.7,label="C-term 690-788",color="#c0392b")
axs[1].axvline(R,ls="--",color="grey"); axs[1].legend()
axs[1].set_xlabel("distance from concave centre (A)"); axs[1].set_ylabel("residues")
axs[1].set_title("The C-terminal domain sits inside the solenoid concavity")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
